title: Pipedrive
description: Exposes the Pipedrive CRM REST API v1 as agent tools.
Covers deals, persons, organizations, activities, pipelines, stages, notes, leads,
products, files, users, teams, goals, projects, and every other v1 resource.

pipedrive.apiToken.title: API Token
pipedrive.apiToken.description: Pipedrive API token (Settings -> Personal preferences -> API), or an OAuth access token. Tokens starting with a JWT-style prefix are sent as a Bearer header; everything else is sent as the api_token query parameter.

pipedrive.companyDomain.title: Company Domain
pipedrive.companyDomain.description:
Just the subdomain: the acme in https://acme.pipedrive.com, not the whole URL. Requests then go to https://acme.pipedrive.com/api/v1.

Leave it blank to use the shared https://api.pipedrive.com/api/v1 host. An API token belongs to one company, so a domain from a different account fails as a 401 or 404 on every tool rather than as an obvious configuration error.

pipedrive.readOnly.title: Read-only mode
pipedrive.readOnly.description: When enabled, every create, update and delete tool is blocked, and the generic request tool only accepts GET. Safe for agents that should only inspect the CRM.

pipedrive.toolGroups.title: Tool groups
pipedrive.toolGroups.description:
Which groups of Pipedrive tools this node publishes to the agent. A group is one resource area of the CRM; every tool belongs to exactly one, and a group you do not select is invisible to the agent.

The full v1 surface is 255 tools, which is well past the point where an LLM picks the right one reliably, and every published tool spends context on every turn. So pick the smallest set that covers the job rather than everything that might one day be useful. Each option shows its tool count; hover an option to see what it covers.

Selections totalling more than 120 tools log a warning and still run. All groups publishes everything and skips that warning.

enum: Deal records and everything hanging off them: products, participants, followers, files and the change log. Includes deal_list, deal_create, deal_search and the deal_summary and deal_timeline roll-ups.
Contacts: create, update, merge and search people, plus the deals, activities and files attached to them. Includes person_list, person_search and person_merge.
Companies: create, update, merge and search organizations, plus their people, deals, activities and files. Includes organization_list, organization_search and organization_persons_list.
Calls, meetings and tasks, together with the account's custom activity types and fields. Includes activity_list, activity_create and activity_mark_done.
Pipelines and their reporting. Start here to discover the account's pipeline and stage layout. Includes pipeline_list, pipeline_deals_list and pipeline_conversion_stats.
The stages inside a pipeline and the deals sitting in each one. Includes stage_list, stage_deals_list and stage_create.
Notes attached to deals, people, organizations, leads or projects, and the comment threads on them. Includes note_list, note_create and note_comment_create.
Cross-record search for when you do not know which record type holds the answer, plus incremental sync. Includes item_search, lookup, item_search_by_field and recents_list.
Phone call logs and their audio recordings. Includes call_log_list, call_log_create and call_log_recording_add.
Custom field definitions on deals, people, organizations and products. Read this to resolve the 40-character keys custom fields are written with. Includes field_list, field_get and field_create.
Files attached to records, including linked Google Drive documents. Includes file_list, file_create, file_download and file_link_remote.
Saved filters, so an agent can reuse a view the user already built in the Pipedrive UI. Includes filter_list, filter_helpers_get and filter_create.
Sales goals and how far along they are. Includes goal_find, goal_results_get and goal_create.
The Leads Inbox: leads, their labels and their sources. Includes lead_list, lead_create, lead_search and lead_label_list.
Mail threads and messages synced into Pipedrive, and linking a thread to a deal or lead. Includes mail_thread_list, mail_thread_messages_list and mail_message_get.
Account-level odds and ends: currencies, messaging channels, video-meeting links and billing add-ons. Includes currency_list, channel_create and meeting_link_create.
Parent and child links between organizations. Includes org_relationship_list, org_relationship_create and org_relationship_update.
Read-only view of the account's permission sets and who is assigned to them. Includes permission_set_list and permission_set_assignments_list.
The product catalogue, its variations and prices, and the deals each product is attached to. Includes product_list, product_search and product_variation_list.
Projects and the boards, phases, tasks and plans they are made of. Includes project_list, project_create, project_task_list and project_phase_list.
Role administration: create roles, assign users, and control which pipelines and records each role can see. Includes role_list, role_assignment_add and role_pipelines_set.
Recurring and installment revenue subscriptions attached to deals, and their payment schedules. Includes subscription_find_by_deal, subscription_recurring_create and subscription_payments_list.
Teams and their membership. Includes team_list, team_user_add and team_list_for_user.
User accounts, their permissions, settings and connected third-party accounts. Use it to resolve a name to the user_id that owner filters need. Includes user_list, user_me and user_find.
Webhook subscriptions registered by this API token. Includes webhook_list, webhook_create and webhook_delete.
All groups (255) - skips the size warning
Publishes every group, all 255 tools including the raw request escape hatch, and skips the 120-tool warning. Meant for scripted callers: an LLM-driven agent picks badly from a list this long.

pipedrive.allowRawRequest.title: Allow raw API requests
pipedrive.allowRawRequest.description: Publishes the generic request tool, which can call any Pipedrive v1 endpoint by method and path. It uses the same authentication, rate-limit handling and read-only enforcement as the typed tools. Disable to restrict the agent to the typed tools only.
